This document carries several kinds of sensitive value so that a catalog
request for one label can be shown to redact that label and leave the rest
untouched.

The mailing ZIP code is 90210 for the west-coast office.
Reach the desk at contact@example.com during business hours.
The applicant's preferred language is Spanish.

A caller that asks only for postal codes should see the ZIP redacted while
the email address and the language both survive.
